config.title: 技术状态变更单签署完成率

metricNote.displayName: 技术状态变更单签署完成率
metricNote.definition: 变更单中已完成签署的占比
metricNote.formula: 已完成签署数 ÷ (已完成签署数 + 未完成签署 I+II+III) × 100%

sqlConfig.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

config.title: 整改落实完成率(I, II类)

metricNote.displayName: 整改落实完成率(I, II类)
metricNote.definition: I/II 类变更单中已落实整改的占比(III 类不涉及整改)
metricNote.formula: 已落实整改(I,II类) ÷ (已落实整改 + 未落实整改) × 100%
metricNote.scope: 仅 I/II 类变更单,截止结束时间

sqlConfig.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

metricNote.definition: 新增变更单中尚未完成签署的占比
metricNote.formula: 未完成签署(I+II+III) ÷ (I+II+III 类新增总数) × 100%
metricNote.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制(分母);分子截止结束时间

sqlConfig.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(order_signed_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(order_signed_cnt)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "签署完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)::numeric/(SUM(reform_done_i_ii)+SUM(reform_pending_i_ii))::numeric*100,2) END AS "整改完成率", CASE WHEN SUM(total_change_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii))::numeric/SUM(total_change_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "未签署比率" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

metricNote.definition: 综合签署率/整改率/未签署比率得出的健康度评分
metricNote.formula: 签署完成率 × 40% + 整改落实率 × 40% + (100 − 未签署比率) × 20%
metricNote.scope: 需技术状态三项子指标均有数据

sqlConfig.query: WITH agg AS (SELECT SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS order_signed_cnt, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS order_unsigned_total, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS reform_done_i_ii, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS reform_pending_i_ii, SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total_change_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN (order_signed_cnt+order_unsigned_total)=0 THEN 0 ELSE order_signed_cnt::numeric/(order_signed_cnt+order_unsigned_total)::numeric*100 END)*0.4 + (CASE WHEN (reform_done_i_ii+reform_pending_i_ii)=0 THEN 0 ELSE reform_done_i_ii::numeric/(reform_done_i_ii+reform_pending_i_ii)::numeric*100 END)*0.4 + (100 - CASE WHEN total_change_cnt=0 THEN 0 ELSE order_unsigned_total::numeric/total_change_cnt::numeric*100 END)*0.2, 2) AS "技术健康度" FROM agg

config.description: 事实明细表：展示统计周期内技术状态变更事实、签署状态、整改状态和闭环日期。

sqlConfig.query: SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", tech_state_name AS "技术状态名称", change_item AS "更改项目", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", change_category AS "更改类别", file_signature_status AS "文件签署状态", reform_status AS "整改状态", CASE WHEN is_signature_completed THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS "签署完成", change_submit_time AS "提交时间", signature_closure_date AS "签署闭环日期" FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2 WHERE submit_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND submit_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] ORDER BY change_submit_time DESC NULLS LAST

components.name: 技术状态签署整改摘要

config.title: 技术状态签署整改摘要

变更总数.definition: 周期内新增的全部 I/II/III 类技术状态更改单总数
变更总数.formula: 新增 I 类更改 + 新增 II 类更改 + 新增 III 类更改
变更总数.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

I类.displayName: 新增 I 类更改数
I类.definition: 周期内新增的 I 类技术状态更改单数(影响最大)
I类.formula: 更改类别='I' 且 更改提出时间在[开始,结束]内的更改计数
I类.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

II类.displayName: 新增 II 类更改数
II类.definition: 周期内新增的 II 类技术状态更改单数
II类.formula: 更改类别='II' 且 更改提出时间在[开始,结束]内的更改计数
II类.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

III类.displayName: 新增 III 类更改数
III类.definition: 周期内新增的 III 类技术状态更改单数(影响最小)
III类.formula: 更改类别='III' 且 更改提出时间在[开始,结束]内的更改计数
III类.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

已签署.definition: 技术状态变更单中已完成签署的数量
已签署.formula: 完成签署='是' 的变更单计数

未签署.displayName: 技术状态变更单未完成签署(I, II, III类)
未签署.definition: 尚未完成签署的全部技术状态变更单数
未签署.formula: 完成签署='否' 的变更单计数 = I 类未签 + II 类未签 + III 类未签

已整改.definition: I/II 类技术状态变更单中已落实整改的数量
已整改.formula: 更改类别∈(I, II) 且 整改落实状态='已落实整改' 的变更单计数

待整改.definition: I/II 类技术状态变更单中尚未落实整改的数量
待整改.formula: 更改类别∈(I, II) 且 整改落实状态='未落实整改' 的变更单计数

config.description: 指标摘要表：按月度汇总展示变更类别、签署完成和整改落实情况。

sqlConfig.query: WITH agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_change_cnt),0)::numeric AS total_change_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(new_cat_i),0)::numeric AS new_cat_i, COALESCE(SUM(new_cat_ii),0)::numeric AS new_cat_ii, COALESCE(SUM(new_cat_iii),0)::numeric AS new_cat_iii, COALESCE(SUM(order_signed_cnt),0)::numeric AS order_signed_cnt, (COALESCE(SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i),0)+COALESCE(SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii),0)+COALESCE(SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii),0))::numeric AS order_unsigned_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(reform_done_i_ii),0)::numeric AS reform_done_i_ii, COALESCE(SUM(reform_pending_i_ii),0)::numeric AS reform_pending_i_ii FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT v.metric AS "指标", v.value AS "数值", v.note AS "说明" FROM agg CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('变更总数', agg.total_change_cnt, '统计周期内技术状态变更单总量'), ('I类', agg.new_cat_i, '新增I类技术状态变更数'), ('II类', agg.new_cat_ii, '新增II类技术状态变更数'), ('III类', agg.new_cat_iii, '新增III类技术状态变更数'), ('已签署', agg.order_signed_cnt, '已完成文件签署的变更单数'), ('未签署', agg.order_unsigned_cnt, '截至统计周期仍未完成签署的变更单数'), ('已整改', agg.reform_done_i_ii, 'I/II类已落实整改的变更单数'), ('待整改', agg.reform_pending_i_ii, 'I/II类尚未落实整改的变更单数')) AS v(metric,value,note)

config.description: 跟进处置表：聚焦未签署或待整改变更单，展示受影响文件、对象和计划闭环时间。

sqlConfig.query: SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", tech_state_name AS "技术状态名称", change_item AS "更改项目", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", change_category AS "更改类别", file_signature_status AS "文件签署状态", reform_status AS "整改状态", affected_files AS "受影响文件", affected_objects AS "受影响对象", plan_file_closure_date AS "计划签署闭环", plan_reform_date AS "计划整改闭环" FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2 WHERE submit_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND submit_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND (COALESCE(is_signature_completed,false) = false OR COALESCE(is_reform_pending,false) = true) [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] ORDER BY change_submit_time DESC NULLS LAST
